Workflow Commands

Usage: claude-flow workflow <subcommand> [options]

Subcommands:
  - run       - Execute a workflow
  - validate  - Validate workflow definition
  - list      - List workflows
  - status    - Show workflow status
  - stop      - Stop running workflow
  - template  - Manage templates

Run "claude-flow workflow <subcommand> --help" for more info
